answer_1.quote: We combine two techniques for generating the tutor's turn: Fine-tuning an existing generation model and Re-ranking the generated outputs to match the desired hedge strategy.
answer_1.outputs: tutor's utterance u'_i that matches a given hedge strategy (i.e., hedge or non-hedge) l_i, according to the dialogue history h_i

answer_2.quote: To evaluate performance, we used the most widely used set of reference-based metrics for natural language generation tasks.

answer_4.quote: We therefore asked two annotators to ignore sub-categories and annotate only hedge or non-hedge on each tutor turn of the model's output, with access to 4 prior turns of the dialogue history.
